With over a decade of international experience each, Dylan and Hamish have performed for Quincy Jones at the Montreux Jazz Festival , and appeared at leading venues including Ronnie Scott’s , Royal Albert Hall and Blue Note New York . Their collaborations span artists such as Jorja Smith , Loyle Carner and Ezra Collective , with airplay support from Elton John and Giles Peterson . Rooted in this experience, the agency now represents a carefully curated roster of artists we have collaborated with across London’s leading venues — from Vortex Jazz Club, Ronnie Scott's, Andaz Hotels to international appearances in NYC, Morocco and China and high-profile corporate events, including clients such as Netflix .
